bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
case "$(git remote get-url origin)" in *seigo-gace/create-videobot*) ;; *) echo BAD_CREATEVDOBOT_REPO; exit 51;; esac
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
sha="27bcfbc3fb58a004fa9ac6a7881d09ffec36a10a"
git fetch --no-tags origin feat/assistant-ai-and-sales-core
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$sha" || { echo CREATOR_SOURCE_HEAD_CHANGED; exit 52; }
stage="$root/.worktrees/creator-final-flow-27bcfbc"
mkdir -p "$root/.worktrees"
if test -d "$stage"; then
 test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$sha" || exit 53
 test -z "$(git -C "$stage" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" || exit 54
else
 git worktree add --detach "$stage" "$sha"
fi
ids="$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll)"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$ids" | grep -c .)" -eq 1 || exit 55
tag="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Config.Image}}' "$ids")"
case "$tag" in create-videobot:*) ;; *) exit 56;; esac
printf 'CURRENT_CREATOR_IMAGE=%s\n' "$tag"
n=0
for f in src/telegram/creatorUi.mjs src/telegram/creatorWizard.mjs src/telegram/creatorBot.mjs src/telegram/creatorScreenTransport.mjs src/telegram/mediaProcessor.mjs src/telegram/privateMediaUpload.mjs src/runtime/creatorPollingMain.mjs src/runtime/creatorMigrate.mjs src/runtime/creatorMigrateDockerSmoke.mjs src/sales/pgListings.mjs src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs; do
  n=$((n+1))
  expected="$(git show 6ec7ab46bffa88d42791d21d8eb854ca446fa908:"$f" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)"
  live="$(docker run --rm --network none --pull never --read-only --entrypoint sha256sum "$tag" "/opt/videobot/$f" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
  if test "$expected" != "$live"; then
    echo "LIVE_CHANGED_FILE_INDEX=$n"
    echo "LIVE_SOURCE_DIVERGED_NO_WRITE"
    exit "$((60+n))"
  fi
done
echo VIDEO_FLOW_SOURCE_BASELINE_MATCH=11
echo VIDEO_FLOW_PREFLIGHT=PASS
